meta.title: Lootlings Master Universe & Content Bible
meta.purpose: Authoritative pre-production design/source pack for future art generation and Codex implementation.

pillars: Cute first, badass second: tiny mythical relic-beasts carrying absurdly oversized equipment.
Life in the world, calm in the interface, chaos in the rewards.
Readable portrait-mobile silhouettes at 480x854 with subtle actor outlines and strong foreground/background separation.
Auto-combat must remain enjoyable to watch; tapping adds meaningful punch without becoming mandatory.
Loot is physical: chests land, charge, erupt, eject items, settle, then UI summarizes.
Characters are not weapon-locked; every Lootling may eventually use every weapon family.
Progression should become visible through Core glow, gear, trails, cosmetics, poses, and evolved weapon silhouettes.
Offline/local remains a complete game; future online/social systems are additive and server-authoritative.

characters.name: Relic Beast
characters.species: Original relic-beast; cream fur, huge ears and amber eyes, tiny cracked horns, one fang, enormous curled tail
characters.personality: Curious, stubborn, opportunistic, delighted by anything shiny.
characters.backstory: A nameless den-scavenger whose chest Core woke when a buried vault rang beneath the Hideout. It has no famous bloodline or prophecy; it keeps surviving because it pokes everything that glows and runs faster than consequences.
characters.silhouette: Huge ears + curled tail + tiny horns + glowing chest Core + satchel
characters.palette: cream, charcoal, amber-gold Core, scavenged olive/brown gear
characters.pose_notes: Balanced posture; weapon weight is the joke. Ears/tail react to anticipation and rewards.
characters.future_passive: Scavenger's Instinct — first treasure interaction each encounter gains a tiny utility bonus, not raw mandatory power.
characters.starter_pitch: Balanced, adaptable, and ready for any ridiculous weapon.

characters.name: Emberhorn
characters.species: Fox-dragon relic-beast with swept ember horns, compact muzzle, thick expressive tail
characters.personality: Brave, cheeky, impatient, loot-obsessed; treats danger like a dare.
characters.backstory: Emberhorn hatched in the soot vents beneath an abandoned smelter and learned that most locked doors open if hit hard enough. Its Core burns hotter near ancient metal, which it interprets as treasure saying hello.
characters.silhouette: Swept horns + fox ears + flame-tail tuft + broad forearms + hot Core
characters.palette: burnt orange, dark charcoal, brass, ember-red, white-hot highlights
characters.pose_notes: Chest-forward confidence; strong anticipation crouch; attacks overcommit in a charming way.
characters.future_passive: Hot Start — the first damaging hit after a brief lull gains a small fire-flavoured bonus.
characters.starter_pitch: Bold, punchy and built for players who like obvious impact.

characters.name: Mosskin
characters.species: Leaf-eared forest relic-beast with bark plates, mossy mantle and seedpod charms
characters.personality: Patient, protective, dry sense of humour, secretly competitive.
characters.backstory: Mosskin guarded a collapsed waystone shrine long after everyone forgot what the shrine was for. When treasure hunters finally arrived, Mosskin decided the safest place for the relics was apparently in its own backpack.
characters.silhouette: Leaf mantle + low sturdy stance + bark shoulder plates + broad tail frond
characters.palette: moss green, bark brown, pale fern, warm jade Core
characters.pose_notes: Grounded stance, low center of gravity, defensive bracing and protective recovery.
characters.future_passive: Rooted Nerve — the first heavy hit taken in an encounter grants a brief modest guard.
characters.starter_pitch: Steady and forgiving without being slow or boring.

characters.name: Moonkip
characters.species: Long-eared moonlit relic-beast with scarf streamers, compact paws and crescent markings
characters.personality: Playful, smug, curious, steals snacks before valuables and denies both.
characters.backstory: Moonkip grew up inside the roof maze of the old Archive, learning every shortcut and none of the rules. It can hear Relic locks click before they open and has been banned from three vaults it technically discovered.
characters.silhouette: Long ears + trailing scarf + crescent cheek mark + narrow agile body
characters.palette: midnight blue, moon-silver, pale cream, cyan-violet Core
characters.pose_notes: Low crouches, lateral feints, springy recoveries, sharp eye-line toward target.
characters.future_passive: Slipstep — periodic attack/reward interactions grant a tiny burst of tempo or avoidance.

characters.name: Pebblewyrm
characters.species: Chunky juvenile stone-wyrm with crystalline back plates, tiny wings and oversized paws
characters.personality: Sweet, fearless, food-motivated, thinks every problem is pushable.
characters.backstory: Pebblewyrm was found asleep inside a geode that miners mistook for treasure. It woke, ate the claim marker, and followed the nearest Lootling home. Nobody has successfully explained property law to it.
characters.silhouette: Rock plates + crystal nubs + barrel body + tiny wings + massive paws
characters.palette: slate, violet crystal, dusty lilac, bright amethyst Core
characters.pose_notes: Strong squash/stretch; attacks begin compressed and end dramatically extended.
characters.future_passive: Rolling Momentum — repeated successful hits slowly build a tiny impact bonus that resets when combat pauses.

characters.name: Glimmerfin
characters.species: Axolotl-fin relic-beast with luminous frills, glossy eyes and floating droplet motes
characters.personality: Bright, excitable, easily distracted by magical phenomena, compulsive note-taker.
characters.backstory: Glimmerfin emerged from a flooded observatory carrying a staff twice its height and absolutely no explanation for how it learned to use it. Its Core hums in harmony with unstable Relic weather.
characters.silhouette: External frills + round tail fin + luminous droplets + floating focus motes
characters.palette: aqua, sky blue, coral-pink frills, pearly white, cyan Core
characters.pose_notes: Staff/focus anticipation, floating droplets orbit during charge, elastic magical release.
characters.future_passive: Resonance — first status application in an encounter gets a small utility amplification.
characters.starter_pitch: Bright spell effects and expressive magical reactions.

characters.name: Gloomlet
characters.species: Small shadow-bat/cat relic-beast with hood-like ears, winged mantle and lantern Core
characters.personality: Quiet, dramatic, sarcastic, tries very hard to look mysterious while loving praise.
characters.backstory: Gloomlet lived in the sealed ventilation shafts of Hoard Depths and became convinced it was the terrifying spirit of the vault. The first adventurer who offered it dried fruit ruined the legend permanently.
characters.silhouette: Bat-cat ears + wing mantle + narrow tail + dangling lantern-like Core
characters.palette: charcoal, black-plum, magenta-violet, pale eye glow
characters.pose_notes: Low stalking posture, vanish-like compression, fast diagonal release, theatrical victory pose.
characters.future_passive: Opportunist — modest bonus against already-weakened enemies.
characters.starter_pitch: Sneaky, dramatic and built around sharp payoff.

zones.name: Outer Treasure Ruins
zones.story: Broken ceremonial streets around the first vault-mouth. Treasure leaks upward in tiny harmless bursts, which is why every scavenger in three valleys has shown up.
zones.background: Warm moonlit sandstone ruins, tilted pillars, distant treasure glow, blue night sky, hanging vines.
zones.midground: Broken bridges, relic arches, shallow water channels, collapsed market stalls.
zones.foreground: Grass tufts, loose coins, cracked pots, dangling roots, occasional close parallax pillar edge.
zones.palette: navy night, sandstone gold, teal moss, amber relic light
zones.music: Curious adventure; warm pluck, light hand drum, distant bell, gentle relic shimmer.
zones.loot_theme: scavenged starter gear, basic charms, practical weapons

zones.name: Salvage Warrens
zones.story: A buried industrial maze where old carts still roll when nobody touches them and every wall contains something someone else wants.
zones.background: Rusty tunnels, chain lifts, furnace windows, stacked scrap, broken conveyors.
zones.midground: Gear doors, crooked gantries, pipe bundles, mine-cart tracks.
zones.foreground: Hanging chains, sparks, scrap piles, steam puffs, wheel silhouettes.
zones.palette: rust orange, iron blue, soot black, furnace yellow
zones.music: Mechanical adventure rhythm with muted clanks, plucks and low pulse.

zones.name: Hoard Depths
zones.story: The vault proper: part treasury, part nest, part machine that still believes every coin belongs to it.
zones.background: Vast black-violet vault caverns, gold seams, chained doors, distant gem towers.
zones.midground: Treasure terraces, broken statues, enormous locks, dragon claw marks.
zones.foreground: Coin mounds, gem shards, chain silhouettes, heat shimmer near boss chambers.
zones.palette: black-violet, royal purple, molten gold, ember orange
zones.music: Dark treasure pulse with deep drum, low bells, sparse high sparkle.
zones.loot_theme: Epic+ hoard gear, treasure affixes, signature weapons

zones.name: Mossglass Wilds
zones.story: A forest growing through sheets of ancient green glass. Reflections sometimes move before the thing they reflect.
zones.background: Luminous forest, giant glass shards, mist, distant canopy ruins.
zones.midground: Root bridges, mirror ponds, relic obelisks wrapped in moss.
zones.foreground: Large leaves, dew drops, glowing spores, near-camera vines.
zones.palette: jade, fern green, glass cyan, soft gold
zones.music: Woodwind-like synth, soft percussion, watery bells.

zones.name: Moonfen Canopy
zones.story: A flooded canopy-city where rope bridges sway above moonlit marsh water and thieves communicate with lantern flashes.
zones.background: Blue-purple swamp canopy, hanging villages, full moon, fog layers.
zones.midground: Rope bridges, reed huts, lantern posts, broken observatory domes.
zones.foreground: Reeds, fireflies, hanging moss, water splashes.
zones.music: Sneaky plucked motif, brushed rhythm, night insects.

zones.name: Frostbell Hollows
zones.story: Ice caves whose stalactites ring like bells when Relic energy moves underneath them.
zones.background: Blue-white caves, frozen waterfalls, suspended crystal bells.
zones.midground: Ice bridges, frozen vault doors, abandoned camps.
zones.foreground: Snow drift, icicles, breath mist, sparkling frost.
zones.palette: ice blue, white, navy, pale violet
zones.music: Glass bells, soft low drones, restrained drum.

zones.name: Sunken Gearworks
zones.story: A half-flooded machine district where gears turn under black water and treasure floats past in sealed brass tubes.
zones.background: Flooded machinery, brass towers, deep water, shafts of sunlight.
zones.midground: Walkways, sluice gates, paddle gears, pressure tanks.
zones.foreground: Water droplets, pipe edges, bubbles, swinging cables.
zones.palette: oxidized teal, brass, deep navy, white highlights
zones.music: Percussive machinery layered with watery ambience.

zones.name: Cinder Crown Caldera
zones.story: A volcanic crown-shaped crater full of ruined forges and relic-metal that refuses to cool.
zones.background: Black volcanic cliffs, lava rivers, ruined foundries, ember storm.
zones.midground: Forge bridges, slag towers, broken cranes.
zones.foreground: Ash flakes, chains, heat haze, sparks.
zones.palette: black, ember red, molten orange, brass
zones.music: Heavy drum, low horn-like synth, metallic percussion.
zones.loot_theme: fire, heavy weapons, armour, burn signatures

zones.name: Starfall Archive
zones.story: A library-city built around a fallen celestial object. Books reorder themselves when nobody is reading them.
zones.background: Towering shelves, star windows, floating paper, cosmic machinery.
zones.midground: Reading bridges, telescope halls, rotating glyph rings.
zones.foreground: Pages, ink motes, close shelves, floating bookmarks.
zones.palette: midnight blue, parchment cream, violet, star gold
zones.music: Airy choir-like pads, harp/pluck, soft clockwork ticks.

zones.name: Nullglass Expanse
zones.story: A desert of black mirrored sand where unused possibilities gather as ghostly copies of gear.
zones.background: Black glass dunes, violet sky, broken mirrored monoliths.
zones.midground: Relic mirages, shattered archways, floating shards.
zones.foreground: Windblown glass dust, reflection strips, close shard silhouettes.
zones.palette: black glass, violet, cold cyan, white
zones.music: Sparse pulse, reverse textures, distant metallic chimes.

zones.name: Skyhook Bastion
zones.story: A fortress suspended by colossal chains over the clouds. Every bridge is technically temporary.
zones.background: Cloud sea, hanging citadel, giant chains, distant lightning.
zones.midground: Airship docks, rope lifts, chain bridges, banners.
zones.foreground: Cloud wisps, swinging hooks, flags, cable silhouettes.
zones.palette: sky blue, white, navy, brass, electric cyan
zones.music: Adventure march, airy pads, snare-like percussion, electric sparkle.

zones.name: The First Hoard
zones.story: A buried treasury older than the known ruins. The world’s Relic Cores hum toward it as if remembering home.
zones.background: Impossible vault cathedral, layered treasure strata, colossal dormant Core machinery.
zones.midground: Titanic locks, ancient statues, suspended relic planets.
zones.foreground: Gold dust, relic glyphs, giant key fragments, deep shadow framing.
zones.palette: obsidian, ancient gold, white-hot Core light, royal violet
zones.music: Full thematic culmination of earlier motifs with long build and quiet awe sections.
zones.loot_theme: endgame signatures, evolved weapons, prestige cosmetics

weapon_families.name: Maul

evolutions: Bell Maul → Resonant Maul → Cathedral Bell

weapon_families.name: Spear / Halberd
weapon_families.held_angle: 10–15° upward toward enemy, rear hand near hip
weapon_families.motion: brace → straight thrust or sweeping hook → snap recovery

weapon_families.name: Twin Daggers
weapon_families.held_angle: one blade forward 20°, offhand blade reverse-grip near hip
weapon_families.motion: low crouch → crossing slash → spring back

weapon_families.name: Claws / Gauntlets

Cinder Knuckles → Furnace Fists → Caldera Hands
Shade Claws → Gloom Talons → Null Rake

weapon_families.name: Bow
weapon_families.held_angle: bow vertical/slightly canted 5–10°; arrow nocked toward target; never backwards

weapon_families.name: Crossbow

weapon_families.motion: raise → tiny lock/click → bolt launch → mechanical recoil
evolutions: Scrap Repeater → Gear Repeater → Storm Repeater

weapon_families.name: Relic Sling
weapon_families.motion: spin → release arcing projectile → hand follow-through
evolutions: Pebble Sling → Geode Sling → Meteor Pocket

weapon_families.name: Staff
weapon_families.held_angle: 25–35° forward/up; focus tip clear of face
weapon_families.motion: plant/raise → Core/focus charge → arcing cast → magical recoil
evolutions: Cinder Staff → Furnace Rod → Crownfire Branch
Moss Staff → Verdant Rod → Root of the Vault

weapon_families.name: Wand
weapon_families.motion: quick point/flick → fast projectile → tiny wrist recoil
evolutions: Ruin Wand → Vault Wand → First Spark

weapon_families.name: Orb / Focus
weapon_families.held_angle: floating 15–30 px from paw/chest; hand guides rather than grips
weapon_families.motion: orbit compresses → focus flashes → projectile/beam → orbit expands
evolutions: Relic Orb → Vault Sphere → Core Satellite
Mirror Focus → Echo Focus → Unchosen Eye

npcs.name: Patch
npcs.visual: small goblin-like artisan; goggles, patchwork apron, magnet tool, one oversized glove
npcs.backstory: Patch claims every item can be repaired exactly once. The second repair is 'creative ownership transfer.'
dialogue: If it sparks, it's either valuable or educational.
That dent? Structural personality.
I can fix it. Define 'fix.'
Don't lick the blue metal. Again.
Bought it cheap. Found it free. Same thing, really.
Legendary? Put it down gently and act like we meant to find it.
You brought me dragon scrap? Oh, we're friends now.
That weapon's balanced. Not physically. Emotionally.
Reroll the stock? Fine. The good stuff was hiding.
Your Stash is full. Congratulations on your problem.

npcs.name: Nym
npcs.visual: hooded small horned keeper; layered violet cloth, floating shard rosary, calm bright eyes
npcs.backstory: Nym listens to Relic Cores the way other people listen to weather. Nobody is sure whether the Cores answer.
dialogue: The Core is louder today.
Power remembers how you used it.
A bright relic is not necessarily a kind one.
You came back carrying more noise than you left with.
Shards don't make choices. You do.
The altar likes you. I remain undecided.
That Legendary is singing through the wall.
Breathe before you spend everything.
Some vaults open with keys. Others open with consequences.
If the Core flickers, step away. Politely.

npcs.name: Quillik
npcs.visual: small feather-crested lizard/bird relic scholar; spectacles, scroll harness, ink-stained paws
npcs.backstory: Quillik started the Archive to record relic history and immediately became distracted cataloguing increasingly stupid weapon names.
dialogue: I filed that under 'bad ideas, successful.'
New trophy! Try not to make the next one medically interesting.
I need the exact name. 'Big purple thing' is not archival language.
Your kill count has become a formatting problem.
Secret achievements are secret. Stop asking.
The dragon entry now has a footnote: 'rude.'
I have three books about that weapon. None recommend swinging it indoors.
You discovered a variant! I discovered paperwork.
Please stop bleeding on the rare manuscripts.
History is mostly people opening things labelled DO NOT OPEN.

npcs.name: Nibs
npcs.visual: tiny round rat-lizard with a coin twice its size and a crooked backpack
npcs.backstory: Nibs has never spoken. Nibs has also never paid for anything.
dialogue: *drags a coin away*
*freezes when noticed*
*pretends the coin was always there*
*squeak of plausible deniability*

npcs.name: Tonk
npcs.visual: stocky mole-badger relic smith; soot mask, huge hammer, tiny reading glasses
npcs.backstory: Tonk used to repair vault doors. Now Tonk makes weapons specifically designed to invalidate vault doors.
dialogue: Evolution isn't magic. It's repeated hitting with paperwork.
Bring me the base weapon, the parts, and unreasonable confidence.
That edge can hold one more mistake.
If it screams during reforging, that's the metal. Probably.
You want elegant? Wrong forge.

npcs.name: Mara
npcs.visual: long-eared desert ferret relic-beast; rolled maps, brass whistle, many tiny stamps
npcs.backstory: Mara sells directions to places she absolutely has not personally verified.
dialogue: Contract says 'minor danger.' Legal definition is flexible.
Someone wants that thing dead. Conveniently, so do you.
I marked the safe route in green. The exciting route is everything else.
Bring proof. Teeth count.
Daily work. Weekly trouble.

npcs.name: Pip & Pock
npcs.visual: two sibling beetle-mouse traders sharing one enormous backpack-cart
npcs.backstory: Pip negotiates. Pock reacts loudly to the negotiation.
dialogue: Pip: Rare stock. / Pock: RARE-ISH!
Pip: One careful owner. / Pock: IT BIT HIM!
Pip: Final price. / Pock: SHE SAID THAT TWICE!
Pip: Ignore him. / Pock: IMPOSSIBLE!

npcs.name: Mote
npcs.visual: floating lantern-creature with tiny paws inside a glass relic shell
npcs.backstory: Mote appears wherever too many Lootlings gather and insists it was invited.
dialogue: Friends incoming. Try to look employable.
Clan banner's crooked. More memorable that way.
Someone waved at you. Social emergency.
Trade table's open. Keep your paws visible.

loading_tips: Oversized weapons are a feature, not a workplace incident.
Run Scrip disappears after a run. Spend it or enjoy the memory.
Scrap buys gear. Gold builds the Hideout. Star Shards annoy the laws of nature.
A Gilded enemy is basically a walking bad financial decision.
If a chest is breathing, that is not normal chest behaviour.
Ranger arrows should come from the bow. We checked.
Staffs cast spells. They are not expensive clubs.
You can leave the merchant with money. Nobody has ever required this.
The Archivist records everything except where Nibs gets the coins.
Legendary beams are intentionally difficult to ignore.
A full Stash is not a tragedy. It is an invitation to scrap responsibly.
Poison is green. This is advanced tactical information.
Volatile enemies advertise the problem before becoming the problem.
The Hoard Dragon considers all treasure personal property.
Your Relic Core is not judging you. Nym might be.
Different weapons should change posture, timing and projectile language—not just numbers.
Small swarms exist to make area effects feel clever, not to turn Lootlings into a horde game.
Secret achievements are secret. Quillik hates this tip.
Mimics rely heavily on you assuming furniture is harmless.
You can use any weapon family with any Lootling once the roster is fully enabled.
Rare gear is exciting. Legendary gear should change a story you tell about the run.
Boss chests wait for you to enjoy the explosion before covering it with menus.
If something sparkles in Hoard Depths, assume it has opinions.
The safest shortcut is rarely the one Moonkip recommends.
Pebblewyrm has never lost an argument with a door.
Emberhorn has never accepted 'locked' as a permanent condition.
Glimmerfin takes notes during explosions.
Gloomlet practices victory poses when nobody is looking.
Mosskin knows patience is a weapon. It is not an exciting weapon, but it works.
The Relic Beast has no class restriction and even fewer regrets.

tutorial_copy.first_attack: TAP THE ARENA to add a bonus attack. Auto-combat keeps moving without you.
tutorial_copy.first_upgrade: Choose one. Builds get stranger when you commit.
tutorial_copy.first_item: EQUIP for the run, KEEP for the Stash, or SCRAP it.
tutorial_copy.first_variant: Variant enemy. Read the tag — weird usually means important.
tutorial_copy.first_chest: Tap when you're ready. Better treasure gets a louder entrance.
tutorial_copy.first_signature: Signature gear changes behaviour, not just numbers.
tutorial_copy.first_trophy: Trophy earned. The Archive remembers what you did, unfortunately.
tutorial_copy.first_merchant: Run Scrip is temporary. Spend it before the run ends.
tutorial_copy.first_hideout: The Hideout is home. Gear, train, shop, check trophies, then head back out.

ui_direction.rule: Life in the world, calm in the interface, chaos in the rewards.
ui_direction.combat_hud: Top-left/upper region reserved for compact wave/zone identity; HP/XP anchored and minimal; statuses use chips; build strip collapses outside combat; battlefield remains visible.
ui_direction.menus: Prefer physical scene art + floating cards/chips over full-screen opaque rectangles. One hero focal point per screen.
ui_direction.trophies: Badge-first gallery with category tabs, recent unlock hero card, progress rings/bars, locked silhouettes, secret question marks.
ui_direction.inventory: Item art first, name/rarity second, 2–3 headline effects, compare/details expandable.
ui_direction.starter_select: Large character hero art, 5-pose preview carousel, short personality/playstyle, lock reason if unavailable.
ui_direction.loading: Short illustrated postcard/scene with one quip/tip; never fake a loading wait.

audio_vfx_direction.music: Original long-form location identity; avoid fatiguing exposed sine loops in production. Use adventure motifs that can recur across zones.
audio_vfx_direction.combat_sfx: Multiple variants per frequent event; emphasize body/transient at low-mid frequencies; limit high-pitch repetition.
audio_vfx_direction.chest_rare: low resonance + quick ascending 2–3-note cue + blue burst.
audio_vfx_direction.chest_epic: rumble + rising harmonic layer + brief duck + violet burst sting.
audio_vfx_direction.chest_legendary: deep treasure resonance → rising tonal/percussive build → 100–200 ms micro-silence → wide gold impact + melodic sting; never harsh or clipped.
audio_vfx_direction.outline: subtle local actor outline; stronger only for elite/boss. No full-screen outline shader.
